About Us

Welcome to Unofficial Royalty! We are a community that enjoys learning about royalty, past and present. In 2025, Unofficial Royalty was ranked #1 on Feedspot’s 15 Best Royal Family Blogs and Websites in 2025.

We invite you to keep up with what is happening here by bookmarking the Unofficial Royalty website at https://www.unofficialroyalty.com/,  joining us on Facebook at the Unofficial Royalty Facebook Group, and on X, formerly Twitter, at Unofficial Royalty @UnofficialRoyal.

Deven is the owner of the website, and as chief administrator, he is responsible for the technical side of the website. Scott and Susan deal with the day-to-day administration of the website, which includes overseeing the royal news area and researching, writing, and publishing articles for the various content areas.

One of our most popular features is the royal news. Royal News Recaps are published Mondays to Fridays and on Sundays except for Thanksgiving Day in the United States, Christmas Eve, and New Year’s Eve. The Royal News Recap for Sundays will be a weekend recap. If there is any breaking or major news, we will publish a breaking news article and/or a recap as necessary.


Our History

What began as a simple news site in 1995 by Geraldine Voost quickly evolved into the site we have today. Geraldine began posting royal news articles and was soon inundated with questions about the British royals.  A FAQ section was added, as well as a Yahoo group.  In 1997, she decided to consolidate everything into one site, establishing Unofficial Royalty and adding content areas for a number of royal families as well as an integrated discussion forum.

By 2009, we had a team of volunteers helping with the daily news updates, contributing content for the various royal families, moderating the discussion forums, and writing featured columns for the site.  We decided to move the site to a new domain – www.unofficialtoyalty.com – with a new content management system to make it easier to maintain.

In 2010, Geraldine handed over the day-to-day administration of Unofficial Royalty to Scott and Susan in order to focus on her passion for competitive ballroom dancing.

As of January 1, 2012, the site was sold, with Deven, a long-time contributor to the site, taking the reins. Scott and Susan continue as site administrators. In the tradition of Unofficial Royalty’s founder, Geraldine Voost, Unofficial Royalty remains a website administered by a team of volunteers.


Cover Photo

The cover photo at the top of the page was taken by Susan on one of her trips to England, showing Buckingham Palace in London, England.


Contact Us

Before you contact us, please read the bulleted items below. Do not send us any email that deals with any bulleted items. You are wasting your time because we are not interested.

Please be advised that:

Unofficial Royalty is not a business. It is a website based in the United States and administered by a team of volunteers.
Unofficial Royalty is not interested in any project or collaboration that involves the exchange of money.
Unofficial Royalty does not use sponsored posts or sponsored link insertions.
Unofficial Royalty does not deal with marketing agencies.
Unofficial Royalty does not accept any type of advertising.
Unofficial Royalty does not purchase any services or products.
Unofficial Royalty does not do any type of private research or private genealogy research, so please do not email us about such matters. If you have a question about royalty or want to start a discussion, please post on our Facebook page: Unofficial Royalty Facebook Group

PLEASE DO NOT SEND US ANY EMAILS DEALING WITH THE ABOVE MATTERS.

We cannot put anyone in direct contact with any royal family members. However, we do have this resource at Unofficial Royalty: Current Monarchies: Official Websites, Social Media, and Mail Addresses.

Before you contact us, please read the bulleted items above. Do not send us any email that deals with any bulleted items. We are not interested.

Have questions or comments about Unofficial Royalty?  Please email us at one or both of the addresses below, and we will respond as quickly as possible. However, please do not email us questions about royalty or ask us to do any private research. If you have a question about royalty or want to start a discussion, please post on our Facebook page: Unofficial Royalty Facebook Group.

susan@unofficialroyalty.com

PHOTOS: While many photos used on Unofficial Royalty come from the public domain and our personal collections, we do also use photos found elsewhere on the internet. The use of these photos is not intended to imply ownership or copyright of the images, and we try to include the source whenever possible. If you are the owner of any photo used, please contact us, and we will gladly remove the image.
